manager.title: Clients
manager.settings-description-entity: Open a {{entity}} to set its folders, email, sharing, and privacy.
manager.description: A client groups one client's work under one or more workspace folders. Files in a client's folders are scoped to that client so other clients' data never appears.
manager.client-name-helper: Optional. The company or organization this client belongs to, if any.
manager.empty: No clients yet. Create your first client above.
manager.no-folders: Open a workspace to map folders to this client.
manager.no-mail-accounts: Connect an email account in Settings to map it to this client.
manager.mail-account-hint: Email from a mapped account is scoped to this client.
manager.privileged-hint: When this client is active, network plugins and MCP servers are turned off so nothing can leave your machine through an extension. Unrelated to email sensitivity tagging.
manager.mcp-access-label: Allow connected external AI tools to access this client's files
manager.mcp-access-hint: Off by default. Turning this on lets external AI tools connected to {{productName}} (via the MCP protocol) read this client's files, even when another client is active.
manager.firm-share-action: Share this client with my firm
manager.firm-leave-hint: This removes the firm link. Your local files stay on your machine.
manager.firm-leave-confirm: Stop sharing this client with my firm? My local files stay on my machine.
manager.firm-invite-new-user-hint: This email is not in your org yet. I'll create their account and show you a temporary password to share with them.
manager.firm-temp-password-hint: This is the only time this password is shown. Copy it now.
manager.firm-remove-member-confirm: Remove {{email}} from this client? Their key access will be rotated.
manager.firm-key-blocked: Waiting for your firm admin to grant this device access to this client. I'll open it automatically once they do.
manager.firm-invite-user-exists: {{email}} already has an account. Use the admin console to add them, or ask them to accept an invitation.
manager.isolated-confirm-body: Network lockdown blocks all network-capable plugins and MCP servers while this client is active. AI requests stay on this computer; nothing can leave through an extension. You can turn this off at any time.
manager.isolated-affirmation: This client is now isolated. AI requests stay on this computer, and outside network connections are blocked so nothing can leave this client.
manager.isolated-off-hint: Network lockdown turned off for this client.
manager.description-entity: A {{entity}} groups one client's work under one or more workspace folders. Files in a {{entity}}'s folders are scoped to that {{entity}} so other clients' data never appears.
manager.empty-entity: No {{entityOther}} yet. Create your first {{entityOne}} above.
manager.sample-hint-entity: This is the built-in training {{entity}}. Deleting it removes the demo questions.
manager.delete-sample-confirm-entity: This removes the sample {{entity}}, and the demo questions will stop working. Continue?
manager.delete-confirm-entity: Remove the {{entity}} "{{name}}"? Your files stay on your computer, but this {{entity}}'s folder and email mappings, notes, and saved state are cleared. This can't be undone.
manager.no-folders-entity: Open a workspace to map folders to this {{entity}}.
manager.no-mail-accounts-entity: Connect an email account in Settings to map it to this {{entity}}.
manager.mail-account-hint-entity: Email from a mapped account is scoped to this {{entity}}.
